observations: Photo 0: single used tire on floor, tread visible, no sidewall text legible, a person's leg visible in background.
Photo 1: close-up of tread pattern on same or similar tire, watermark 'D-KACHI ENTERPRISE' overlaid, no size or brand text visible on tread.

Photo 2: two tires stacked, sidewall of top tire shows partial text 'MASTER-GRIP' but no full brand, model, size, or DOT date code legible, watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'D-KACHI ENTERPRISE' overlaid.
No full sidewall shot showing size (e.g., 205/55R16), load/speed rating, manufacture date, or full brand name.
No shots of the inner sidewall, bead area, or any patch/plug repairs.
No visible cracks or bulges but sidewalls are not fully shown in any photo.

identity.kind: used (Tokumbo) car tire, set of at least 3 visible

claims.evidence: No grading marks or certification visible in any photo; 'first grade' is a seller characterization, not shown.

claims.claim: will last almost like new brand ones
claims.evidence: Tread depth cannot be measured from photos; no ruler, gauge, or wear-bar close-up shown.

risks.risk: Tire size unknown, which drives most of the price difference between tire sets.
risks.proof: A clear, well-lit photo of the full sidewall showing size markings (e.g., 205/55R16).
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest common size tier until confirmed

risks.risk: Tire age/manufacture date unknown; old rubber can be unsafe even with good tread.
risks.proof: Close-up of the DOT code on the sidewall showing week/year of manufacture.

risks.risk: Brand/model only partially visible ('MASTER-GRIP'), cannot confirm quality tier.
risks.proof: Full sidewall photo showing complete brand and model name.

risks.risk: Hidden sidewall damage, bulges, or repairs not shown.
risks.proof: Photos of both sidewalls of each tire from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having possible sidewall damage

risks.risk: Actual tread depth not verifiable from photos alone.
risks.proof: A photo with a tread depth gauge or coin inserted in the grooves.
risks.if_unproven: priced as minimum legal tread depth

risks.risk: Number of tires in the set unclear (photo 0 and 1 may show same tire, photo 2 shows two).
risks.proof: A single photo showing all tires being sold laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: priced per tire until count confirmed

proof_requests: Clear photo of the full sidewall of each tire showing size, brand, and model.
Close-up of the DOT date code on each tire.
Photo of all tires in the lot laid out together to confirm quantity.
Tread depth gauge or coin test photo.
Photos of inner sidewalls for damage or repairs.
response.reason: The size and full brand/model of the tires, which are the main price drivers, are not legible in any photo, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without a clear sidewall shot.
